baseline_prompt:
def is_sorted(lst):
    '''
    Given a list of numbers, return whether or not they are sorted
    in an order. If list has more than 1 duplicate of the same
    number, return False. Assume no negative numbers and only integers.
    '''

Clarification: 'Sorted' means ascending order specifically. A 'duplicate' means an equal adjacent/repeated value; if any number appears more than twice in the list (i.e. more than one duplicate occurrence of the same number), the function should return False even if the list is otherwise in ascending order.
question: What defines a "duplicate occurrence" of a number in the context of this function?
answer: Per the reference, it counts how many times each distinct value appears in the list; if any value appears more than twice (count > 2), the function returns False regardless of order. Exactly two occurrences of a value is allowed; three or more is not.
